reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.unit_cost_eur
FROM products p
WHERE p.unit_cost_eur > (
  SELECT AVG(p2.unit_cost_eur)
  FROM products p2
  WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id
)
alternatives:
WITH category_avg AS (
  -- one row per category
  SELECT category_id, AVG(unit_cost_eur) AS avg_cost_eur
  FROM products
  GROUP BY category_id
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.unit_cost_eur
FROM products p
JOIN category_avg c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE p.unit_cost_eur > c.avg_cost_eur

other_way.sql:

  SELECT category_id, AVG(unit_cost_eur) AS avg_cost_eur
  FROM products
  GROUP BY category_id
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.unit_cost_eur
FROM products p

other_way.tradeoff: A step with one average per category, joined back to the products, shows every average but takes more lines.
